derivedFrom: the captured news payload read through the rules in section 11 and section 17, not from a run. The count per name is the articles the payload attributes to that name, recomputed in the suite from the same capture, and a member the day wrote nothing about carries zero rather than no row.

rules.oneRowPerMemberPerDate: including the members the day wrote nothing about, because the pulse is compared against its own baseline and a night missing from the series would read as a night nobody counted
rules.pagedUntilTheDayIsCovered: every page counted, and the page count follows the day's news volume rather than the size of the universe
rules.populationIsTheIndex: not every symbol the market wrote about: one live request reached 3,232 distinct symbols against an index of 503
